description: Header file defining functions and data structures for automatic neighbor addition in wireless access points and radios, including configuration and reload functions.

methods.name: wld_autoNeighAdd_vapSetDelNeighbourAP
methods.description: Adds or deletes a specific access point from the neighbor list of other access points.

methods.name: wld_autoNeighAdd_radioSetDelNeighbourAP
methods.description: Adds or deletes access points of a specific radio to the neighbor list of other access points in other radios.

methods.name: wld_autoNeighAdd_vapReloadNeighbourAP
methods.description: Reloads a specific access point into the neighbor list by deleting and then setting it.
